integrity: The all-dimensional statement is proved symbolically from the level structure, image contractibility, and minimal-space rigidity. Exhaustive computations for n=1,2,3 are supporting checks only. A directly inaccessible older foundational source is not treated as inspected; the needed rigidity fact is taken from a full-text primary restatement.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for ordinary unbased homotopy of self-maps of the canonical minimal finite sphere models and is stated for n>=2. It does not classify nonminimal finite sphere models or higher homotopy groups of their mapping spaces. The n=1 case was already covered by a prior broader height-two result.
title: Exact self-homotopy classes of minimal finite sphere models
